subtitle: What IAM alone can't do: stop at one column, not a whole table

caption: An IAM role, granted specific Catalog permissions through Lake Formation

eyebrow: The grain IAM alone can't reach
caption: Database, table, and column-level permission checkboxes

eyebrow: LF-Tags: tag it once, grant by tag
code:
aws lakeformation create-lf-tag \
  --tag-key sensitivity \
  --tag-values public pii confidential

aws lakeformation add-lf-tags-to-resource \
  --resource '{"TableWithColumns":{...,
    "ColumnNames":["customer_ssn"]}}' \
  --lf-tags '[{"TagKey":"sensitivity","TagValues":["pii"]}]'
caption: A new table tagged next month is covered immediately — no new grant needed

subtitle: Checking the assumption every pipeline before this one made
